_doc: Semantic palette of the top-down town plans (tools/city/fal_planos.py asks fal for them, tools/city/desde_imagen.py reads them back into the grid; docs/protocolos/generar-ciudad.md §1e). Each class: its flat colour in the image, the words the prompt uses and, for a landmark, the landmark type of data/maps "landmarks". A pixel goes to the class of the nearest colour (within max_dist); a tile to the class most of its pixels have.

grass.words: open grass and gardens: light green

street.words: streets, lanes and alleys: medium grey

plaza.words: market squares and church squares: beige

dock.words: wooden piers and quays over the water: brown

rock.words: bare rock of the mountain: dark brownish grey

quarry.words: the stone quarry pit: very light grey
